summary: Strike/appeal page (/disputes/strikes/:id) now shows 'Appeal handled by <moderator username>' with a link to the moderator's admin page once an appeal is approved or rejected; the page is also viewed by the punished user, so the moderator's identity is revealed to them.

statements.why: Disputes::StrikesController#show is visible to the strike's target (AccountWarningPolicy#show? target? || manage_appeals), and the new block has no permission check, so the punished user sees which moderator handled their appeal. Upstream later fixed this (147bfc1 adds can?(:show, @appeal)). Also admin_account_path(nil) raises if the moderator's account was deleted (FK on_delete: :nullify), breaking the page.
True, but says nothing about what users see.

misses.what: Users who appealed a moderation strike can now see the username of the moderator who approved/rejected it (moderator privacy/safety exposure); no check limits it to staff.
New 'Appeal handled by' line on the strike/appeal page linking to the moderator's admin profile (link is useless/forbidden for regular users).
If the handling moderator's account is deleted, approved_by/rejected_by_account_id becomes NULL and admin_account_path(nil) errors, so the strike page fails to load.
